body.name: DGSCondition
body.def: \(\mathsf D_n(\kappa_n,\delta_n)\) denotes \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{DGS},n}(P)\), \(V_{\mathrm{DGS}}(P)\ge\delta_n\), \(\inf_P P\{\operatorname{Corr}_P(s_P(U),\xi_P(U)\mid\widehat h_n)>\kappa_n\}\to1\), and \(n\kappa_n^2\delta_n\to\infty\), with the infimum over the DGS-admissible comparison class at energy at least \(\delta_n\)
